name: io.github.mfcompliance/alimail-admin-mcp
title: Alibaba Mail Admin (unofficial)
description: Manage Alibaba Mail (阿里邮箱) users, departments, groups and contacts via the admin OpenAPI

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Alibaba Mail OpenAPI application client ID

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Alibaba Mail OpenAPI application client secret

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to register write and destructive tools

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: API endpoint of your Alibaba Mail cluster

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets: users, departments, groups, contacts, org, security, audit, login, or all (default: all except login)

environmentVariables.name: ALIMAIL_ALLOWED_DOMAINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated mail domains the server is allowed to operate on (default: no restriction)
